label: Immune metabolic remodeling during exercise rehabilitation: Linking skeletal muscle regeneration, bone homeostasis, and systemic immune adaptation.
summary: Exercise rehabilitation harnesses immune metabolic remodeling to drive coordinated skeletal muscle regeneration, bone homeostasis, and systemic immune adaptation. Physical activity functions as a controlled metabolic stressor that reprograms immune cell metabolism-shifting macrophages from glycolytic M1 to oxidative M2 phenotypes, expanding regulatory T cells through fatty acid oxidation and ketone body signaling, and modulating neutrophils, NK cells, and B cells via lactate, succinate, itacona…
